title: Agentic AI Security Webinar
summary: Secure your agentic AI ecosystem with Xerox IT Solutions and Palo Alto Networks. Explore risks, guardrails and security controls for autonomous AI agents.
body_markdown:
## AI is rapidly evolving from a tool that generates content to autonomous systems capable of making decisions, executing actions, and interacting directly with business applications.


While these agentic AI capabilities unlock tremendous efficiency, they also introduce new security and governance challenges that traditional controls were never designed to address. In this session,[Xerox® IT Solutions](https://www.xerox.com/en-us/services/it-solutions) and Palo Alto Networks will explore the emerging landscape of Agentic Endpoint Security (AES), including the risks associated with autonomous agents, AI-enabled workflows, and machine-driven decision making. Attendees will learn how organizations can gain visibility into AI activity, establish appropriate guardrails, and apply modern security controls to a rapidly expanding AI ecosystem.


### Agentic AI Security: Securing the Next Generation of Autonomous Systems featuring Palo Alto Networks October 22, 2026 at 11:00 AM CST


60-Minute Live Session + Q&A


#### What you'll learn


-


Why agentic AI introduces fundamentally different security risks than traditional software or generative AI tools.


-


Common attack paths involving autonomous AI agents, AI-powered workflows, and machine identities.


-


How to discover, monitor, and govern AI agents operating across your environment.


-


Strategies for implementing guardrails, access controls, and oversight mechanisms for autonomous systems.


-


How Palo Alto Networks approaches visibility, threat detection, and protection for emerging AI workloads.


-


Key considerations for building an AI security program that supports innovation while managing risk.


Watch the replay
